scenario: A precision above 20 on `f` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_INTERP_BAD_FORMAT per LGRA.2.9.6.5. Pin: `{t.v:.21f}` on a Float slot parses under LGRA.2.9.6.1's grammar (`dsc.strlit.lgra_2_9_6_1_format`, which admits any precision up to the wire's uint32) and is refused by the precision-above-20 rule in `dsc.validate.lgra_2_9_6_5_refusals` -- the compiler's refusal, since neither loader checks a precision. LGRA.2.9.6.5h is the boundary twin at 20.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    k: Int key
    v: Float mutable

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    log info "v: {t.v:.21f}"
